experiments.scope: Exact blake3-r2-prefix-v1 on 33-byte messages, matching only the first 16 digest bits with 8-bit table halves and 255 samples per organizer seed. Exhaustive finite detector checks and exact rational budget checks run before the trials.
experiments.hypothesis: The partition/tag detector returns a distinct-message pair whenever the finite sample contains a repeated 16-bit key. This tests implementation and target encoding, not a full collision or a probability extrapolation.
